correctness.rationale: A 7-cycle on seven of eight labels acts freely on simplices since a matching contains at most four edges but every nonfixed graph edge has orbit size seven. Quotient f-vector (4,30,60,15), Euler 19. Every size-three matching extends to a unique perfect matching, allowing 15 free face pairs and a 2-complex (4,30,45). Contract three tree edges and eliminate 26 generator/relator pairs (each generator occurs precisely once in its chosen attaching word); certificate final 19 exponents lie in 7Z, at least one ±7, hence Moore M(Z/7,1) plus 18 null-attached two-cells, a wedge of 18 S². Independently formed all orbit chain matrices and exact integer SNF: d1 rank3, d2 rank27 with sole nonunit factor7, d3 rank15, ∂²=0; this confirms H1,Z7 and H2,Z18 but does not by itself prove wedge. The inspected complete 26-step attaching-word certificate plus standard homotopy moves supplies that stronger step.
